title: Decision
description: A choice that was made, why it was made, and what it was chosen over.
guidance: One decision per record: the choice and why it won, not a summary of the discussion. Record it the moment it is settled — a decision nobody wrote down is one the next session will make again, differently.

supersedes.description: The earlier decision this one replaces.

references.description: Another record this one rests on, cites or is about.
